beginner.title: Get started with UpToDate
beginner.outcome: You can: set up UpToDate, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Find answers fast
beginner.outcome: You can: search UpToDate efficiently at the point of care
beginner.practice: Answer three clinical questions from your practice

beginner.title: Read with judgement
beginner.outcome: You can: understand strength of evidence
beginner.practice: Compare UpToDate's advice with a local guideline

intermediate.title: Drugs and calculations
intermediate.outcome: You can: check doses and interactions safely

intermediate.title: Use on mobile
intermediate.outcome: You can: use UpToDate quickly on a phone
intermediate.practice: Set up bookmarks for your top 10 topics

intermediate.title: Signature skills in UpToDate
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make UpToDate distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced UpToDate
expert.outcome: You can: use UpToDate's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Teach and audit with it
expert.outcome: You can: use UpToDate for teaching and CPD
expert.practice: Turn one topic into a teaching session

expert.title: Integrate UpToDate into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect UpToDate with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect UpToDate to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use UpToDate well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use UpToDate" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
